concept_card.statement: In SHM, speed peaks at the mean, acceleration peaks at the extremes, and total energy stays constant.
concept_card.analogy: Like money shifting between wallet and pocket: the split changes, the total doesn't.
steps: v = ω√(A² − x²) is zero at the extremes.
a = −ω²x is largest at the extremes.
concept_card.worked_example: m = 0.5 kg, k = 50 N/m, A = 0.1 m: ω = 10 rad/s; extreme a = 10 m/s², mean v = 1 m/s; E = 0.25 J throughout.

remediation_cards.wrong_idea: It stops at the end, so the acceleration there must be zero.
remediation_cards.why_it_feels_right: Things at rest usually feel force-free, and zero speed sounds like nothing is happening.
remediation_cards.why_wrong: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity. At the end the spring is stretched most, so a = −ω²x is largest; velocity is zero for only an instant.
remediation_cards.correct_idea: At the extreme, velocity is zero but acceleration is maximum, ω²A, toward the mean.

remediation_cards.wrong_idea: The energy is biggest in the middle where it moves fastest and drops at the ends.
remediation_cards.why_it_feels_right: You can see the speed, so kinetic energy feels like all of the energy.
remediation_cards.why_wrong: At the ends the kinetic energy has turned into potential energy, ½kx². With no damping nothing is lost, so KE + PE = ½kA² at every point.
remediation_cards.correct_idea: Total mechanical energy stays the same throughout an ideal oscillation; only the KE/PE split changes.

contrast_probes.probe: At the extreme point, which quantity of the block becomes zero: its acceleration or its total energy?
contrast_probes.reply_if_first: Its acceleration, because the block has stopped there.
contrast_probes.reply_if_second: Its total energy, because it has no speed there.

contrast_probes.probe: At the extreme point the block is at rest for an instant. Is its acceleration there zero, or the largest in the whole cycle?
contrast_probes.reply_if_second: The largest, because the spring is stretched the most there.

contrast_probes.probe: Compare the block's total energy at the extreme point with its total energy at the mean position. Which is bigger?
contrast_probes.reply_if_first: The mean position, because it moves fastest there.
contrast_probes.reply_if_second: Neither, they are equal; only the KE and PE split is different.
